يستحلفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَحْلِفُوا (yastaḥlifū) /jas.taħ.li.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# يُسْتَحْلَفُوا (yustaḥlafū) /jus.taħ.la.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
